prompts.walk: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is an existing production game sprite sheet. Change ONLY the HAIR COLOR on EVERY character frame from orange/copper/redhead to LIGHT NATURAL BLOND: pale wheat-gold base, creamy pale yellow highlights, muted sandy/tan shadows. Hair must clearly read as blond, not orange, not red or copper. Keep dark outline and original shading contrast. Do not change the hair silhouette, pose, face, glasses, skin, red shirt, blue shorts, yellow backpack or red shoes. Preserve exact frame order, grid layout, empty gutters, full bodies and every animation pose. Do not add text, ground or shadows. Keep genuine alpha transparency outside sprites. This is a palette correction, not a redesign. Keep EXACT 5 columns x 4 rows, 20 sprites. Preserve source left/right directions, including any existing mirrored frames; do not correct poses or directions. Maintain relative scale across all 20 frames.
